ja.title: このアトラスでできること
paragraphs: 大学院生・研究者と、調査や実装を支援するAIのための数値計算資料集です。分野地図から手法を選び、適用条件・数式・一次文献を読み、公開コードとデータまでたどれます。
代表20問題には、固定入力・実行手順・JSON/CSV出力・結果の判定基準があります。Poisson方程式、Barnes–Hut、水素型原子・Heなどを手元で実行し、解析解・数値参照・残差などと照合できます。
AIからは、静的本文とJSON/Markdown、版を固定したコード・入力・検証記録を参照できます。人もAIも、使える条件と確認範囲を読み、出典を残して利用するための入口です。

en.title: What you can do with this atlas
paragraphs: A numerical-computation resource for graduate students, researchers and the AI assistants supporting their work. Use the field map to choose a method, read its assumptions, equations and original papers, then follow the links to public code and data.

Twenty representative problems include fixed inputs, execution steps, JSON/CSV outputs and acceptance criteria. Run examples such as Poisson, Barnes–Hut and hydrogenic/He atoms locally, and compare results with analytic solutions, numerical references or residual checks.

AI agents can consult static text and JSON/Markdown, and retrieve versioned code, inputs and verification records. Both people and AI can inspect the conditions and scope of each check and retain the sources when reusing the material.

en.status_note: Educational code, reading only and planned implementations are distinct. The 20 recipes select paths through 65 problems. The field-evidence page separates references, refinement checks and unimplemented scope. This is not a general molecular/periodic DFT solver.
en.meta_description: Connect numerical methods, assumptions, equations and original papers with public code and data. Explore twenty fixed-input examples, including Poisson, Barnes–Hut and H/He atoms, with execution and result checks in English and Japanese.
